title: Right to Equality (Arts. 14-18)
quote: Equality and arbitrariness are sworn enemies - E.P. Royappa (1974)

boxes.title: Articles 14-18
head: Art.
Content
rows: No discrimination on religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth - **citizens only**; 15(2) binds private persons
Public employment; 16(2) adds **descent, residence**; 16(3) residence by **Parliament only**

boxes.title: Rule of Law & classification
items: **A.V. Dicey** (**1885**): no arbitrary power; equality before law; primacy of rights
==India accepts only (i) and (ii)== - rights flow from the Constitution
Classification twin test: ==**intelligible differentia + rational nexus**==

items.what: **M.R. Balaji**: caste not sole test; below **50%**
==**Indra Sawhney**==: **27%** OBC, creamy layer, **50%** cap, no promotion quota (**6:3**)
**Samatha** (AP): no tribal land leases to non-tribals
**Jarnail Singh**: no backwardness proof; creamy layer for SC/ST promotions

boxes.title: Article 18 & awards
items: **Balaji Raghavan** (**1996**): Bharat Ratna, Padma **not titles**; no prefix/suffix

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Right to Equality → ==**Art. 14**== (APPSC 2025); Art. 15 citizens only (2018)
Not covered by Art. 15: **aged persons** (APPSC GS 2023)
⚠ other notes: Davinder Singh = SCs only
